tools.name: element
tools.title: Element
tools.summary: Element properties, electron configuration, isotopes; or the periodic table

query.description: Symbol, English name, or atomic number (e.g. Fe, iron, 26). Leave empty for the full periodic table.
query.label: Element
query.title: Query

tools.name: units
tools.title: Units
tools.summary: Chemistry unit conversions: energy, cm⁻¹/nm/K, dipole, polarizability, rate constants, pressure, charge

query.description: A value and unit, optionally with a target unit (e.g. 1 eV to kcal/mol, 300 nm, 760 Torr to bar). A group name (e.g. pressure) lists its units; leave empty to list all units.
query.label: Conversion
query.title: Query

temperature.description: Temperature for the RT and kT values shown with energies: a number in K, or with a unit (25 C, 77 F).
temperature.label: Temperature (for RT, kT)
temperature.title: Temperature

show_all.description: Also show less common units of each group.
show_all.label: Show all units
show_all.title: Show All

tools.name: xyz
tools.title: XYZ viewer
tools.summary: Paste XYZ coordinates: formula, molecular weight, closest atoms, and a 3D view

text.description: XYZ coordinates: standard XYZ (one or more frames), or just 'element x y z' lines. In the terminal: a file path, or pipe the text in.
text.label: XYZ coordinates
text.title: Text

frame.description: Frame to show first (1 = first). Default: 1.
frame.title: Frame

style.description: How atoms and bonds are drawn.
style.title: Style

tools.name: stereo
tools.title: Stereoisomers
tools.summary: All stereoisomers of a SMILES: R/S and E/Z labels, relations, 2D and 3D

smiles.description: SMILES of the molecule, e.g. CC(Br)C(Br)C. Stereo marks (@, /, \) already in the SMILES are kept unless --enumerate-all is given. Simple condensed formulas such as CH3-CH(OH)-CH3 are also accepted.
smiles.label: SMILES
smiles.title: Smiles

max_isomers.description: Largest number of stereoisomers to make. More takes longer.
max_isomers.label: Max isomers
max_isomers.title: Max Isomers

enumerate_all.description: Also enumerate the stereo centers already given in the SMILES.
enumerate_all.label: Enumerate specified centers too
enumerate_all.title: Enumerate All

tools.name: profile
tools.title: Energy profile
tools.summary: Energy profile A → TS → products: rate constants, half-lives, kinetic and equilibrium ratios; or Boltzmann populations

mode.description: reaction: A → TS → products. populations: Boltzmann populations of states.
mode.label: Mode
mode.title: Mode

paths.description: Reaction mode: one path per line, 'product  TS  product-energy', relative to the reactant A (e.g. 'B 20.0 -3.0'). Use '-' for an unknown value.
paths.label: Paths
paths.title: Paths

states.description: Populations mode: one state per line, 'label  energy  [degeneracy]  [property ...]'. Absolute energies (e.g. in hartree) are fine.
states.label: States
states.title: States

unit.description: Unit of the energies (Eh: populations mode only).
unit.label: Energy unit
unit.title: Unit

ts_values.description: What the TS column holds: the barrier ΔG‡, a rate constant k (s⁻¹, or M⁻¹ s⁻¹ for bimolecular), or a half-life (e.g. 30min, 2h).
ts_values.label: TS values are
ts_values.title: Ts Values

product_values.description: What the product column holds: ΔG, or the equilibrium constant K.
product_values.label: Product values are
product_values.title: Product Values

temperature.description: Temperature: a number in K, or with a unit (25 C, -78 °C).
temperature.label: Temperature
temperature.title: Temperature

molecularity.description: unimolecular: k in s⁻¹. bimolecular (A + B): k in M⁻¹ s⁻¹, 1 M standard state.
molecularity.label: Molecularity
molecularity.title: Molecularity

partner.description: Bimolecular: concentration of the other reactant in M, for pseudo-first-order half-lives (default 1 M).
partner.label: Partner concentration (M)
partner.title: Partner

control.description: activation: k from the barrier only. diffusion: bimolecular rates limited by diffusion, 1/k = 1/k_act + 1/k_diff.
control.label: Control
control.title: Control

solvent.description: Diffusion control: solvent viscosity at 25 °C (or custom).
solvent.label: Solvent
solvent.title: Solvent

viscosity.description: Diffusion control with a custom solvent: viscosity in mPa s (= cP).
viscosity.label: Viscosity (mPa s)
viscosity.title: Viscosity

standard_state.description: Standard state of the energies. 1 atm (gas-phase calculations) is converted to 1 M for bimolecular steps.
standard_state.label: Energies are for
standard_state.title: Standard State

target_half_life.description: Find the temperature at which each path has this half-life (e.g. 1h).
target_half_life.label: Target half-life
target_half_life.title: Target Half Life

target_selectivity.description: Find the ΔΔG‡ needed for this selectivity: a ratio (95:5), an ee (90% ee), or a dr (10:1 dr).
target_selectivity.label: Target selectivity
target_selectivity.title: Target Selectivity
